title: Reversing a list does not change its length
statement: Reversing a list of naturals does not change its length.

formal.statement: theorem List.length_reverse : ((x0 : Sort (1)) -> ((x1 : List.{0} x0) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (List.length x0 (List.reverse x0 x1)) (List.length x0 x1)))
